contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ [VICTORIAE DD NN AVG ET CAES]

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Magnentius or Decentius (350-353), Reece period 18. Obverse description: Bust draped and possibly cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: lost [ DN MAGNENTIVS PF AVG]. Reverse description: Two Victories facing each other holding shield. Reverse inscription: [VICTORIAE DD NN AVG ET CAES]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this probably clipped coin, which has been heavily cleaned, citing Sear 1981 page 328 no. 3927. Diameter: 19.8mm, Weight: 2.69gms, die axis: 12
